etsy.title: Regulation Station Sign, Calm Down Corner Poster, Self Regulation Classroom Decor, Counselor Office Art
etsy.description:
A gentle Regulation Station sign for calm down corners and emotional regulation spaces.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a classroom calm corner, counselor's office, or home regulation space.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy 'Regulation Station' items include step-by-step posters, framed rainbow prints, shirts and a floor mat; calm corner results are mostly multi-poster printable bundles.
Pastel, boho and rainbow styles dominate.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon calm-corner sets are 8-12 poster packs (feelings charts, coping skills) at 11x14 to 11x17, often boho, for counseling and therapy offices.
Many regulation posters on Amazon use a named curriculum brand; this listing avoids that name since the poster does not depict it.

research.notes: Removed the 'Zones of Regulation' title phrase and tag: it is a curriculum trademark the poster does not depict. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
